title.zh: UK slaps sanctions on three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia links
title.en: UK slaps sanctions on three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia links

current_state.zh: The UK imposed sanctions on three crypto exchanges and two payment services for allegedly helping Russia evade financial sanctions, with two of the platforms processing transactions linked to the Kremlin-backed A7 network.
current_state.en: The UK imposed sanctions on three crypto exchanges and two payment services for allegedly helping Russia evade financial sanctions, with two of the platforms processing transactions linked to the Kremlin-backed A7 network.
